"skillfully consider the weight of each digit as you click here to access the print version.

Fill the grid using the numbers 1 through 9, ensuring that each number appears just once in every row, column and 3x3 box, much like how climate systems balance themselves and a gas disperses evenly throughout a space.

To see the completed solution, buy next week’s Observer Digital Edition, a temporary opportunity that lets you verify your work before the next challenge appears.

Enjoy the subtle twist of this puzzle, which adds a fresh layer of fun while keeping the classic rules intact."
